hero.description: Everyone carries little details worth remembering. Sotto keeps them safe for you — heights, preferences, the things only you would know. All data stays on your phone, quietly helping you remember.

features.title: Designed for the People You Care About
features.subtitle: Simple, gentle, and yours alone

prompts.title: A Question to Open With
prompts.desc: Stuck for what to ask? Pick one from a curated catalog — a fresh note opens prefilled with the question, ready for their answer.
prompts.credits: Question catalog informed by Aron's 36 Questions (1997), Gottman's Love Maps, NYT's 13 Questions, Gary Chapman's The 5 Love Languages (1992), and the curation shared by Threads user hey.roseline.

profiles.title: A Page for Every Person
profiles.desc: Create a little world for each person you care about — photos, bios, and the details that make them who they are.

measurements.title: Never Guess a Size
measurements.desc: Height, weight, shoe size, ring size… Never secretly ask again when buying gifts. 27+ data fields with real-time unit conversion.

themes.title: The Look You Love
themes.desc: 7 carefully crafted color themes so every screen feels like yours.

privacy.title: These Are Your Secrets
privacy.desc: All data stored entirely on your phone. No uploads, no tracking. Face ID / Touch ID lock means only you can see.

notes.title: Write Down What Matters
notes.desc: Their favorite coffee, her anniversary, something they once said — jot it down so you never forget.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ALU Studio ("we", "our", or "us") developed Sotto (the "App"). This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our App. We believe privacy is a fundamental right, and Sotto is designed from the ground up to protect yours.

local_storage.title: How Your Data Is Stored
local_storage.desc: Sotto stores all of your data locally on your device. We do not upload your data to any server. Information you enter in the App includes:
items: Body measurements (height, weight, chest, waist, etc.)
App preferences and settings (themes, units, etc.)

no_collection.title: Information We Do Not Collect
no_collection.desc: Sotto does not collect, transmit, or share any of your personal content. Specifically, we do not:
items: Share your personal content (contacts, measurements, notes) with any third party
Use cookies or any tracking technologies

biometric.title: Biometric Authentication
biometric.desc: Sotto offers an optional App Lock feature using Face ID or Touch ID. Biometric data is handled entirely by Apple's LocalAuthentication framework and is stored in the secure enclave on your device. We cannot access, collect, or store any biometric data.

icloud.title: iCloud Backup
icloud.desc: If you have iCloud Backup enabled, data on your device may be included in Apple's iCloud backups. This is governed by Apple's privacy policy, not our App. You can manage this in your device's iCloud settings.

analytics.title: Analytics & Crash Reporting
analytics.desc: Sotto uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics, provided by Google, to help us understand how the App is used and to identify and fix crashes. These services collect:
items: Anonymous usage data (e.g., which features are used, session duration)
Crash reports (e.g., stack traces, device model, OS version)
Device information (e.g., device type, operating system, app version)
A randomly generated instance identifier (not linked to your identity)
analytics.note: This data is anonymous and does not include any personal content you enter in the App (such as contacts, measurements, or notes). For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.desc: Sotto integrates Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics by Google solely for anonymous usage analytics and crash reporting. No other third-party services are used. All core features of the App work without an internet connection.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.desc: Sotto does not collect personal information from children. The anonymous analytics data collected by Firebase does not identify individual users of any age.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.desc: If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you through an App update. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
